allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Little Red Riding Hood: A classic story, but there's more to every tale than meets the eye. Before you judge a book by its cover, you've got to flip through the pages. In the re-telling of this classic fable, the story begins at the end of the tale and winds its way back. Chief Grizzly and Detective Bill Stork investigate a domestic disturbance at Granny's cottage, involving a karate-kicking Red Riding Hood, a sarcastic wolf and an oafish Woodsman.

facts.title: Hoodwinked!

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Everyone caught at Granny's cottage has an entirely different version of the incident. Whose perspective actually explains how they all arrived there?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: When an altercation erupts at Granny's cottage, Chief Grizzly and Detective Bill Stork interrogate a karate-kicking Red, an oafish Woodsman, and a sarcastic Wolf to piece together the truth from the end backward.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: A funny, lighthearted animated whodunit that keeps family movie night brisk, engaging, and easy to enjoy.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Cory Edwards flips a traditional fairy tale into a witty, fast-talking crime mystery that pieces together conflicting witness stories with playful comic energy.
